text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Arima Kinen, a fierce contest to end the year. And there, standing in her way…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Are T.M. Opera O and Meisho Doto. The ultimate duo that has seized first and second place in countless senior G1 races. They are quite literally the best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the race approaches, the venue stirs with tangible excitement…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: She's different from my friend in every way. I can't see it… The shape of her soul…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Nope, I'm simply not feeling it. I'm not getting any sense that our performances would mesh.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: She's far too bizarre to be my costar. Operetta and horror are fundamentally different, you see.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, um, let's just try and get along…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no signs of a rivalry sparking between the two. It feels more like a contest between entirely different genres…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You must not obstruct the adrenaline! Listen, you have to let it flow through you! Flow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe gives a slight nod to Agnes Tachyon's encouragement. I head over to her.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: We're… Our path… is to reach my friend, no matter what…
choice_data_list: Right, and now's the time to do it!
Right, and now's the time to do it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She got so close to her at the Kikuka Sho. Which means this time…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe is even stronger today. She can do it. She can reach her friend and realize the dream she's harbored since childhood.
